error.captcha_service: The browser service could not mint a captcha: key refused, no units left this month, or a challenge it could not solve.

user.title: Setup integration
user.description: With a key, the integration solves the login captcha itself and renews the token when it expires. Your credentials never leave Home Assistant: the remote service only mints the captcha. Browserless gives 1000 free units a month and each login spends about 11. Without a key, you have to paste the token by hand.
